requirements.title: Define ERP core capabilities and ownership boundaries
acceptance_criteria: Classify each candidate capability under Platform, CRM, ERP, or a public channel and record owner, consumers, current evidence, scope and next decision.
Separate baseline ERP capabilities from approved MVP, follow-up and open scope; market references do not automatically become LoopDev requirements.

requirements.title: Define shared, sector-neutral ERP Products master data
acceptance_criteria: Products, services, variants, offers and prices have one ERP-owned contract that CRM and channels reference rather than duplicate.
The conceptual master distinguishes finished products, raw materials/components and services; semimanufactured items remain deferred until Manufacturing discovery.

Item class is independent from whether the item is purchasable, sellable or inventory-tracked; categories are managed within Products, the product base has one general category, and every separately managed/sold SKU has its own independently assigned category.

Finished products allow buy/make/both sourcing; raw materials/components are buy-only for now; services have no sourcing; variants inherit product sourcing. Separately managed/sold variants have their own SKU, while descriptive attributes alone do not create variants.
Products is the user-facing module and direct list entry point; existing catalog-named data, operation IDs and permissions remain compatible until their migration is explicitly approved.
Persistence, permission and platform behavior are verified independently for domain, renderer and user operations before claiming parity.

requirements.title: Generate immutable LoopDev identifiers and SKU values
acceptance_criteria: The database UUID remains the immutable technical primary key; users cannot choose or edit it.
LoopDev generates numeric, organization-unique, immutable internal keys for products and variants.
LoopDev generates numeric, organization-unique SKUs for products and variants; direct users cannot choose or change them.

A trusted future integration may replace the LoopDev SKU with the external system's SKU while preserving the internal key and recording source provenance; channel integration itself remains out of scope.

requirements.title: Manage the hierarchical product category tree within Products
acceptance_criteria: Category tree administration is available within Products, not as a separate Catalog module.

Each product and variant has a LoopDev-generated, immutable internal key distinct from SKU and unique within the organization; changing SKU does not change either key. Categories also have a LoopDev-generated immutable key distinct from visible name and unique within the organization. Each separately managed/sold SKU has its own primary category and an SKU unique across the organization after trimming outer whitespace and comparing case-insensitively; stored SKU preserves entered case. The product base has one general category. Draft products/SKUs may omit category, but category is required before activation. Category is independent from item class and sourcing.
Legacy records with an ambiguous item class are not guessed into a new class; preserve them as drafts until reviewed and assigned.

Archiving a category preserves existing product/SKU assignments and blocks new assignments; permanent deletion is prohibited; restore re-enables assignment when the parent is active; moving a category moves its subtree and preserves assignments without cycles; archiving is blocked while active children remain.
Moving a category moves its descendant subtree, preserves product/SKU assignments and cannot create a cycle or cross-organization parent link.
Read/manage operations have explicit authorization and desktop/mobile-web semantic parity before implementation is considered complete.

requirements.title: Manage reusable image assets for Products and variants
acceptance_criteria: Products operators can browse an organization-scoped image library, upload images through the shared Files capability, and attach an existing image to a product or variant.
The same image file can be reused by multiple product/variant associations within its organization without duplicating binary content; cross-organization association is rejected.
Users can edit approved file metadata and alt text for product imagery; exact metadata ownership and fields are resolved in the design/domain contracts.
Product/variant media associations reference shared Platform File records; ERP does not create a parallel uploader, preview pipeline or binary-storage system.
This scope does not publish or synchronize images to ecommerce, Shopify or social channels and does not expose public storage URLs.

requirements.title: Maintain a non-accounting unit purchase-cost reference for Products
acceptance_criteria: A product without separately managed SKUs or an individual SKU can carry a unit purchase-cost reference with an explicit currency.
The reference is not accounting/inventory valuation, manufacturing cost, sales price or margin; the product UI never derives or displays margin from it.
Cost values are not exposed by `catalog.read` by default; a separate visibility/management permission and audit policy must be approved before implementation.
Product/SKU ownership, default/inheritance behavior, currency defaults, source/history and migration are resolved in domain/access/API/sync tasks before the capability can be built.

requirements.title: Reuse CRM ownership for customer relationships
acceptance_criteria: ERP transactions reference CRM customer/contact identity where applicable and do not create a parallel relationship-history master.

requirements.title: Prioritize a Shopify-connected ERP workflow for MiauCraft
acceptance_criteria: Shopify remains MiauCraft's public sales platform; initial synchronization scope, source of truth and allowed writes are explicitly approved.
The approved connector is tenant-scoped, idempotent, observable and recoverable, with evidence for errors and reconciliation.

requirements.title: Design native LoopDev commerce for Inhand after MiauCraft
acceptance_criteria: The approved first-release design targets physical products, one warehouse, a LoopDev-owned commerce backend and an external payment provider.
Order, stock, tax, shipping, returns and storefront operations have explicit lifecycle, permissions and acceptance evidence before implementation starts.

approval.approval_source: User approved automatic LoopDev-generated identifiers and future external SKU import; see minoveaz/loopdev-v2#37.

acceptance_criteria: Database and local adapters generate numeric internal keys and SKUs organization-wide for products and variants.
Normal product and variant UI flows do not accept user-entered keys or SKUs; generated values are displayed read-only.
Existing product/variant UUID primary keys remain unchanged; existing LoopDev sample variant keys are migrated without changing product relationships.
Only trusted server-side integration writes can replace the generated SKU with an imported external SKU; this task does not build a channel connector.
Focused adapter, component and migration validation passes; remote deployment remains gated by the shared Platform audit and deployment checks.

change_requests.source: User decision: Suppliers is a standalone ERP module because it can be highly relevant depending on the company; its priority and delivery date remain open. Manufacturing is deferred to future discovery. Recorded in design.md and architecture-design.md.

User instruction: "vale pero ajusta todo el flow para cambiar el modulo de catalogo por el de productos". Products becomes the user-facing ERP module and direct product/service list entry point. Preserve CAP-ERP-CATALOG, current catalog-named data/contracts/permissions and existing route as compatibility evidence. OrganizationCatalog is migration-only, not a target grouping or product-ownership boundary. No production route or data migration is included in this design change.

User-confirmed product decisions in this conversation: one Products master; classes for finished products, raw materials/components and services; semimanufactured items deferred until Manufacturing discovery; item class independent from purchasing, selling and inventory-tracking uses; the category tree is managed within Products and each product has one primary hierarchical category; finished products allow buy/make/both sourcing, raw materials/components are buy-only for now, services have no sourcing, and variants inherit product sourcing; separately managed/sold variants have their own SKU, while other attributes remain descriptive. OrganizationCatalog is migration-only, not a target business entity or product-ownership boundary; commercial price currency is owned by each PriceBook, PriceEntry inherits that currency, and Offer has no independent currency. No production code or runtime data changes are authorized.

User approved full-page product/SKU record and create/edit pages with drawers for quick auxiliary-reference management, then selected: "Coste de compra unitario de referencia por producto/SKU, no contable". The reference is not accounting/inventory valuation or margin calculation. Brands/tags lifecycle, cost visibility/currency/inheritance and physical-field ownership remain open for specialized analysis.

User decision recorded in minoveaz/loopdev-v2#37: LoopDev generates the SKU and internal key automatically; users cannot change them; a future integration imports the external system SKU. Approval is limited to ERP-IDENTIFIERS-001; no channel connector, numeric UUID primary keys, other ERP tasks or remote rollout is approved.

User asked to add product images and a place to reuse images for ecommerce/social use, then approved: product/variant assets with a reusable library, metadata and alt text, without automatic publishing. Scope is limited to image asset management inside Products; no channel connector, publication, video, social scheduler or external system is authorized.
